chunks: From him, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Jamil ibn Darradj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who divorced his wife, then left her until her waiting period expired, then married her again, then divorced her again without having intercourse with her, until he did that three times. He said: She is not permissible to him until she marries a husband other than him.

key_terms.تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ: She marries a husband other than him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man divorces his wife three times without consummating each marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the specific mechanism of 'Taliq al-Kula' (divorce without consummation) in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from the general triple divorce. It establishes that three separate instances of divorcing and remarrying without sexual intercourse do not constitute the final barrier, requiring the woman to marry a new husband and consummate that marriage before becoming lawful to the first husband again.
